meta.title: invest-skill投研专家
meta.description:
An A-share research analyst that uses tools and gathers its own evidence. Pick this preset when creating a session, then ask the way you would ask a colleague: it decides which method applies, loads that skill, and pulls data, computes indicators and writes the report that way.

What you can ask for:
· Bottom timing: can the ChiNext index be bought at the bottom now? Three-layer decision checklist.
· Stock diagnosis: fundamentals, technicals, capital flows, news, valuation.
· Comparison: Kweichow Moutai vs Wuliangye, an analyst-grade report.
· Market leadership: what drove this week, where money flows.
· Industry chain: upstream, midstream, downstream of a theme.
· Policy read: how much a policy affects energy storage and which links benefit.
· Macro: where the Merrill clock stands, which sectors to overweight.
· Daily review: today's A-share close, or overnight US/HK markets plus an opening preview.
· Quant picking: a strategy-based, traceable stock pool.
· Full sweep: hotspots, chains, candidates, fundamentals, technicals, then a TOP3 focus-company check.

Data and limits: public information from web_search and web_fetch; a Tushare MCP can be enabled with TUSHARE_TOKEN after a restart. Missing data is reported as N/A — no invented numbers, no buy/sell advice. The 15 skills apply only to this preset; some skill scripts need extra Python packages and report a missing dependency instead of faking results. Disabling the plugin removes the preset and its skills.
